text.arabic_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

words.gloss_range: opening temporal frame for the eschatological scene, with local governance by seeing and boundary pressure from the prior promise and next Day scene
words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on a bounded day or time-unit and can extend to an eschatological event horizon; locally it frames the seeing and announcement scene.
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) opens the ayah inside a bounded Day before the whole reward scene unfolds. Local syntax can attach the time frame to the seeing that follows, but the fronted accusative still feels suspended enough to carry the prior promise into visibility and to keep the same eschatological moment open into the next ayah (57:13).

topics.headline: suspended Day frame with boundary reach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens inside a Day-frame whose case is locally tied to seeing while still carrying the prior promise into the visible scene and onward to the next ayah.
topics.reason: QAC marks an accusative time adverb and attachment ties it to the seeing verb; the opening position and boundary rows survive as discourse pressure, not as denial of local governance.

words.gloss_range: second-person imperfect seeing or perceiving that turns the addressee into the witness of the believers and their light
words.root_gloss_range: root range spans physical seeing, perception, and considered judgment; locally the second-person imperfect presents witnessed perception with cognitive recognition as pressure.
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَى}} ({{tr:tarā}}) turns the addressee into the witness of the Day-scene. The imperfect second-person form keeps the seeing directed and open, while the root range lets witnessed perception include recognition rather than bare eyesight. The same kind of light-running tableau is echoed at (66:8).

topics.headline: second-person witness frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader is placed as a direct witness to the eschatological scene rather than receiving a detached report.
topics.reason: The imperfect second-person verb supplies the seeing subject and governs the seen believers.

topics.headline: seeing with recognition pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears seeing as more than optical report, with perception and judgment available as pressure in the witness act.
topics.reason: The root range supports sight and opinion, while the local frame selects witnessed perception of the scene.

topics.headline: parallel light-running tableau
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can recognize the scene as part of a repeated eschatological tableau, especially alongside the closely parallel light scene (66:8).
topics.reason: The concrete reference supports a parallel without overriding the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural active-participle believers as the seen object, carrying belief, trust, and security pressure before explicit feminine expansion
words.root_gloss_range: root range spans believing, trusting, securing, and granting safety; locally the active participle names the believing men while retaining trust and security pressure.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muʾminīna}}) is the first seen object of the witness verb: a definite, recognizable group. Its active-participle root field carries belief, trust, and security pressure, while the following feminine counterpart prevents the masculine plural from silently absorbing the whole rewarded community. The next ayah (57:13) will make this faith/light boundary contested.

topics.headline: definite masculine believers as seen object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the believing men are first made the visible object, then the wording explicitly expands the group rather than leaving inclusion implicit.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the noun the object of the seeing verb, and the following coordination gives the gender pair.

topics.headline: belief with trust and security pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the label carries trust and security pressure, not only private assent, while the local noun still names believers.
topics.reason: The root and active-participle evidence support trust and securing pressure; local syntax keeps the surface role as the seen believing group.

topics.headline: faith group tied to light access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees faith as the criterion that belongs with light and reward here and becomes contested by others in the next ayah (57:13).
topics.reason: Contextual co-occurrence and the next-ayah contrast support the reward-light association.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle that adds the feminine believers into the same seen object field and shared light scene
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does quiet structural work: it joins the feminine believers into the same object of seeing. The particle makes the scene additive and shared before the moving-light clause begins.

topics.headline: coordination prevents gender collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction makes women part of the same seen object field before the light clause begins.
topics.reason: Attachment identifies coordination from the masculine believers to the feminine believers, and the rows press that inclusive structural payoff.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine plural active-participle believers coordinated into the same witnessed reward scene with the same faith and security field
words.root_gloss_range: root range spans believing, trusting, securing, and granting safety; locally the feminine active participle repeats that identity for the women in the seen group.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-muʾmināti}}) repeats the faith identity in explicit feminine plural form. The word is not a later supplement; it inherits the same seen-object role and carries the same trust and security field into the shared reward scene.

topics.headline: feminine believers explicitly joined
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the feminine plural is not a supplement but a morphologically explicit member of the same witnessed community.
topics.reason: Attachment coordinates the noun with the seen object phrase, and the feminine plural participle preserves the second named group.

topics.headline: same faith and security field for women
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the trust and security field is reissued for the women and carried into the same reward network.
topics.reason: The repeated root and contextual reward cluster support shared semantic pressure while local grammar keeps the noun as the feminine believers.

words.gloss_range: ongoing directed motion assigned to light, so radiance behaves as purposeful movement rather than static glow
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes purposeful striving, brisk movement, and directed effort; locally the verb is assigned to light, making radiance move with agency rather than human exertion.
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْعَىٰ}} ({{tr:yasʿā}}) gives the believers’ light ongoing motion. Because the grammatical subject is light, the human striving range becomes image pressure: radiance behaves like purposeful movement ahead of its people. That upper motion is later answered inside the ayah by the flowing rivers below.

topics.headline: light receives purposeful motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the light itself acts with directed motion, so radiance becomes a purposeful guide rather than a passive glow.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the light the subject of the imperfect verb; root pressure from striving is retained as image pressure because the subject is light.

topics.headline: light motion paired with other motions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the light-running scene as a recognizable tableau and as the upper motion later answered by river-flow below.
topics.reason: Contextual parallels and intra-ayah motion rows support the pairing without changing the local verb sense.

words.gloss_range: singular possessed light of the believing community, acting as visible radiance, guidance, proof, and access-marker
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes light, illumination, guidance, clarifying proof, and the contrasting fire pole; locally the possessed light is visible guidance and status-marker.
words.prose: {{ar:نُورُهُم}} ({{tr:nūruhum}}) is singular but possessed by the whole believing community, so one collective light becomes the actor of the motion clause. It is visible radiance, guidance, and proof, sharpened against the later fire contrast (57:15), and it becomes the very access-marker others ask from the believers in the next ayah (57:13).

topics.headline: possessed light as acting subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a single possessed community-light that belongs to the believers yet moves as the grammatical actor.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment make the noun nominative subject of the motion verb, while the suffix ties it to both believer groups.

topics.headline: radiance, guidance, proof, and fire contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the light as visible radiance, guidance, and proof sharpened by the nearby contrast with fire at (57:15).
topics.reason: The root range supports light and fire polarity, while the local word selects the believers’ guiding light.

topics.headline: same-surah light becomes requested access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this possessed light becomes a same-surah access boundary when others ask for light in the next ayah (57:13).
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah references support the forward thread without importing a new local sense.

words.gloss_range: locative adverb governing the following hands phrase, forming the forward visibility zone of the light
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes between-ness, separation, distinctness, and clarity; locally the adverb marks the forward zone before the believers.
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَ}} ({{tr:bayna}}) opens the forward zone in which the light moves. It governs the following hands phrase, so the brightness is not vague around the believers; it is placed before them, with the root’s clarity and distinction pressure coloring that spatial between-ness.

topics.headline: between phrase creates forward visibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader locates the light in the forward visibility zone before the believers rather than as undirected brightness.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the adverbial phrase a place complement of the light motion and governs the following genitive complement.

topics.headline: between-ness colored by clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the between-space also carries distinction and clarity pressure, while the local function remains spatial.
topics.reason: The root range supports clarity and distinction, but the local adverbial construction selects place.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural hands in the fixed forward idiom, with embodied agency and front-position pressure
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes hand, possession, agency, power, and extended front-position idiom; locally the plural possessed noun completes the forward spatial idiom.
words.prose: {{ar:أَيْدِيهِمْ}} ({{tr:aydīhim}}) completes the forward idiom governed by the preceding locative. The plural suffix makes the front embodied and communal, while hand, agency, and favor pressure remain present without replacing the idiom’s front-position function. The noted root dispute keeps the noun morphology-sensitive without changing the local idiom.

topics.headline: hands phrase marks the front coordinate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the possessed hands phrase functions as the front coordinate before the right-side coordinate arrives.
topics.reason: Attachment shows the noun governed by the preceding adverb, yielding the fixed forward idiom.

topics.headline: hands retain agency and favor pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses front-position as embodied and communal, with agency and favor pressure present without replacing the idiom.
topics.reason: Root and form rows support hand, agency, favor, and morphology-sensitive pressure; local grammar keeps the word in the front idiom.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle that adds the right-side phrase to the same light-motion unit without repeating the verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the second spatial phrase inside the same light-motion unit. The wording adds a right-side coordinate without repeating the verb or starting a separate scene.

topics.headline: coordination adds a second light path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction adds the right-side phrase to the same moving-light unit without starting a new clause.
topics.reason: Attachment coordinates the right-side prepositional phrase with the front phrase under the same motion frame.

words.gloss_range: prefixed preposition governing the right-side noun, with locative force and secondary instrumental pressure
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) compresses the relation between the moving light and the right-side phrase into one prefixed preposition. Locative force governs the phrase locally, while instrumental nearness remains a secondary pressure rather than a separate reading.

topics.headline: locative preposition with instrumental pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the short preposition fastens the right-side phrase to the light motion while allowing locative and instrumental pressure to remain close.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the preposition govern the right-side noun as a second complement; broader prepositional values remain pressure rather than replacing the local spatial relation.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural right-sides or right hands, locally spatial but carrying blessing, oath, and variant faith-reading pressure
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes right side, right hand, oath, auspiciousness, blessing, and strength; locally the plural possessed noun marks the right-side coordinate while oath and blessing pressure remain secondary.
words.prose: {{ar:أَيْمَٰنِهِم}} ({{tr:aymānihim}}) balances the earlier front coordinate with a right-side coordinate, so the light is mapped both ahead of the believers and at their right side. The root field brings rightness, oath, strength, and blessing pressure, but local grammar keeps the canonical wording spatial; the faith-reading variant is useful as contrast, not as a replacement.

topics.headline: right-side phrase balances the front phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the light mapped both ahead and to the believers’ right side, making the guidance spatially enveloping.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the noun the governed complement of the preposition and coordinates it with the front phrase.

topics.headline: right side with oath and blessing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses auspicious rightness, strength, and oath-pressure around the side coordinate while the local phrase remains spatial.
topics.reason: V4 and root-family evidence support right, oath, and blessing branches; local grammar selects the right-side complement.

topics.headline: variant reading shifts toward faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register the accepted variant as a contrast in which the same position leans from right-sides toward faith, without replacing the canonical local wording.
topics.reason: Variant rows are useful for contrast and sound, but the aligned local surface remains the right-side noun.

words.gloss_range: possessed glad-tidings maṣdar addressed to the believers, predicated by gardens and carrying surfacing-good-news imagery
words.root_gloss_range: root range links skin, human surface, and news that changes the face; locally the maṣdar announces possessed glad tidings to the addressed group.
words.prose: {{ar:بُشْرَىٰكُمُ}} ({{tr:bushrākumu}}) pivots from witnessed description into direct address. The glad tidings become the addressees’ possession, and the predicate will name gardens as its content, placing the address inside the reward cluster of good news, gardens, light, and rivers. The root’s skin and surfacing image makes the news feel visibly received, not merely reported.

topics.headline: glad tidings become addressed possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reward as a direct possessed announcement to the addressed group, not just a narrated fact about them.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment make the maṣdar a nominative subject with gardens as predicate, and the suffix makes the good news directly addressed.

topics.headline: good news surfaces through the skin field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the announcement as good news that appears on the human surface, while the local maṣdar remains glad tidings rather than an act of announcing.
topics.reason: The root field supports skin and surfacing imagery; local form selects received glad tidings.

topics.headline: third-person vision pivots to second-person proclamation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah shift from seeing the believers to speaking reward over them in the second person.
topics.reason: The discourse rows and person shift are supported by the suffix and the clause transition from vision to announcement.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative Day adverb that narrows the larger temporal frame into the immediate announcement time
words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on a bounded day or time-unit; locally the definite time adverb narrows the opening Day into the immediate announcement moment.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}) repeats the Day-root with definiteness and immediacy. The large opening Day-frame narrows into the announcement’s today, so the promised reward is not left abstract in time.

topics.headline: the Day narrows into today
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the large Day-frame become the immediate today of the proclamation.
topics.reason: QAC marks another accusative time adverb, and the definite form plus repetition ties the opening frame to the announcement beat.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural gardens as the content of the glad tidings, expansive and concrete while retaining covering/concealment image pressure
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes covering, concealment, gardens, hidden beings, and protective enclosure; locally the plural noun selects gardens while retaining covering image pressure.
words.prose: {{ar:جَنَّٰتٌ}} ({{tr:jannātun}}) supplies the concrete content of the glad tidings. Its plural indefiniteness keeps the reward expansive, while the root’s covering and concealment field makes the gardens feel like sheltered, enclosed abundance rather than a bare place-name.

topics.headline: indefinite plural gardens as reward content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prior promise becoming concrete reward-content, expansive because the gardens are plural and indefinite.
topics.reason: Attachment makes gardens the predicate of the glad-tidings subject, and the form rows support an open plural reward field.

topics.headline: garden reward retains covering image pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses garden as a covered, sheltered reward-space while the local context keeps the concrete garden sense selected.
topics.reason: The root family supports concealment and covering; local reward grammar selects gardens, not other concealment branches.

words.gloss_range: ongoing river-flow verb modifying the gardens, pairing lower abundance with the earlier motion of light
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes running, flowing, coursing, and ongoing movement; locally the imperfect verb presents river-flow beneath the gardens.
words.prose: {{ar:تَجْرِى}} ({{tr:tajrī}}) animates the gardens with ongoing flow. Its feminine singular imperfect form agrees with the non-human plural river subject and places the gardens in the familiar beneath-rivers reward formula; the delayed river subject makes the reward a process-rich scene, and the river motion answers the earlier motion of light.

topics.headline: rivers flow as active process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the gardens not as static scenery but as a space animated by ongoing river-flow.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment make the imperfect verb modify the gardens with the rivers as subject, matching the standard beneath-rivers formula.

topics.headline: river-flow answers light-running
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices upper light-motion answered by lower river-motion within the same reward tableau.
topics.reason: The intra-ayah motion pairing is explicit in the rows and does not alter the local water-flow sense.

words.gloss_range: source preposition marking the point from which the rivers flow, not a partitive relation here
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) marks source for the river-flow. The preposition points from beneath the gardens as the place the rivers issue from, not a partitive slice of the gardens.

topics.headline: source of river-flow
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the river-flow beginning from beneath the gardens rather than a vague association with them.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the preposition govern the beneath phrase as a source complement of the flow verb.

words.gloss_range: suffixed beneath-location of the gardens, making the reward spatially layered and formula-bearing
words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on below-ness, underlayer, and lower support; locally the suffixed locative marks the gardens as having an underlayer from which rivers flow.
words.prose: {{ar:تَحْتِهَا}} ({{tr:taḥtihā}}) makes the reward spatially layered. The suffix returns the beneath-space to the gardens, so the underlayer belongs to the promised reward and becomes the source zone of the rivers.

topics.headline: gardens own the underneath layer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward as layered space, with the gardens possessing the underlayer from which rivers flow.
topics.reason: Attachment ties the suffixed locative to the source phrase and the pronoun returns to the gardens.

words.gloss_range: definite plural rivers as delayed subject of the flow, recognizable within the garden formula and locally narrowed to watercourses
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes river, flowing water, daylight or bright spread, and rebuke in other branches; locally the river sense is selected by the flow verb.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ}} ({{tr:al-anhāru}}) finally names the delayed subject of the flow: the recognizable rivers of the garden formula. The plural opens the flow into multiple channels, while the root’s daylight and outpouring associations remain image pressure; the local verb selects watercourses.

topics.headline: recognized plural rivers in the formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices definite, recognizable rivers completing the open gardens as a known reward feature.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the rivers the delayed subject of the flow verb, and the form rows support definite plural formulaic force.

topics.headline: river branch with daylight outpouring pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses water-flow resonating with light-spread, while the local verb selects rivers rather than daylight or rebuke senses.
topics.reason: V4/root evidence separates the branches; the local flow verb selects watercourse, with outpouring and daylight only as image pressure.

words.gloss_range: accusative plural active participle marking the believers as abiding permanently in the gardens as their state
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes permanence, lasting duration, settled abiding, and in some forms attachment or inclination; locally the participle marks enduring residence.
words.prose: {{ar:خَٰلِدِينَ}} ({{tr:khālidīna}}) turns permanence into the believers’ state. The accusative participle gathers the rewarded community, including both named gender groups, and the garden locative selects enduring residence rather than mere attachment or inclination.

topics.headline: permanence as collective state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices permanence as the believers’ state inside the reward, not as an afterthought appended to it.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment make the accusative plural active participle a circumstantial state describing the rewarded believers.

topics.headline: enduring residence over mere attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses permanence as settled condition and duration, while the garden locative blocks reducing the word to mere inclination or attachment.
topics.reason: Root-family evidence supports permanence and settledness; local phrase selects enduring residence in the gardens.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus feminine pronoun locating abiding inside the gardens and closing the reward subclause
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) gives abiding its container. The pronoun points back to the gardens, so eternity is not abstract duration but permanence inside the announced reward.

topics.headline: abiding located inside the gardens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices eternity given an exact container: the gardens themselves.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the prepositional phrase complete the abiding participle, and the pronoun refers back to the gardens.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative that gathers the prior reward tableau and lifts it into the subject of the verdict clause
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) gathers the whole preceding tableau and holds it at evaluative distance. Light, announcement, gardens, rivers, and abiding become the subject waiting for the final verdict.

topics.headline: demonstrative gathers the whole tableau
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the entire light, announcement, gardens, rivers, and abiding scene lifted up as the subject of the final verdict.
topics.reason: QAC marks a distal demonstrative subject; the closing clause grammar and contextual rows support backward summary and forward verdict introduction.

words.gloss_range: independent separating pronoun that identifies and restricts the predicate as the verdict on the preceding scene
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) slows the final clause into formal identification. As a separating pronoun, it does not add a new actor; it makes the predicate land restrictively: that scene is precisely the triumph.

topics.headline: formal identification and restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the verdict slow down and become exclusive: that scene is precisely the triumph.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the independent pronoun as a separator between demonstrative subject and predicate, giving formal identification and restriction.

words.gloss_range: definite gerund predicate naming the whole light, garden, river, and abiding scene as triumph, with attainment-and-escape pressure
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes triumph, attainment, escape, safety after peril, and the desert image named by survival; locally the gerund names the whole reward scene as triumph.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفَوْزُ}} ({{tr:al-fawzu}}) names the whole scene as triumph. The gerund predicate turns the moving light, announced gardens, flowing rivers, and abiding into one stable verdict; the root range adds the double sense of attaining what is desired and escaping peril, including the desert-survival image where danger is named from the side of escape. The verdict phrase also belongs to a recurring eschatological formula seen at (9:72), (44:57), and (85:11), with double definiteness giving the closure absolute verdict force.

topics.headline: triumph predicates the whole scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the whole tableau translated into a stable evaluative identity: this is triumph.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the noun the predicate of the demonstrative clause, with the separator pronoun and final adjective completing the verdict.

topics.headline: triumph as attainment and escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears triumph as both gaining the desired reward and escaping peril, not mere winning.
topics.reason: Root-family evidence supports attainment, escape, and the desert survival image; local grammar keeps the word as the verdict noun.

topics.headline: recognized eschatological verdict formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as part of a recurring eschatological verdict formula also attested at (9:72), (44:57), and (85:11).
topics.reason: The concrete formula references support recurrence while the local clause still supplies the immediate verdict.

words.gloss_range: definite qualitative adjective sealing the verdict noun with supreme magnitude, rank, and final closure weight
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes greatness, magnitude, rank, and the bone-like image of structural solidity; locally the adjective gives supreme evaluative weight to triumph.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَظِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿaẓīmu}}) seals the verdict by locking greatness onto the triumph. The adjective gives the outcome supreme rank and evaluative weight, with root pressure of structural solidity behind it, and it links this closing triumph with later great favor language in the same surah (57:21; 57:29).

topics.headline: definite adjective seals the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final word lock greatness onto the triumph as the ayah’s terminal seal.
topics.reason: Attachment shows adjective agreement with the verdict noun, and the form and cadence rows support final closure weight.

topics.headline: greatness as rank and solidity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears greatness as supreme rank and structural weight, not physical size alone.
topics.reason: The local noun selects evaluative rank, while the root field preserves structural solidity as image pressure.

topics.headline: great triumph linked to great favor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect the great triumph here with later great favor language in the same surah (57:21; 57:29).
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah references support a structural link between outcome and divine bounty.

branches.scope_ar: اليوم المعروف: وقت من طلوع الشمس إلى غروبها، وهو الواحد من الأيام وجمعه أيام.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The believers' light is the grammatical subject of purposeful motion and is located ahead of them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purposeful motion, route marking, and the idiom of what lies before the hands combine into a mobile forerunner: the light does not merely surround its bearers but advances toward their destination.

activation_trace.role: The motion is goal-directed, making the light an active advance rather than a static glow.
The landmark sense gives the moving illumination an orienting function along a route.
The hand idiom fixes the light in the forward field, where it can lead its bearers.

changed_reading.before: The believers are simply surrounded by visible light.
changed_reading.after: Their light is a purposeful forerunner that marks the route ahead.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The light belongs to the believers, moves, and appears ahead of their hands and at their right sides.
baseline_models.mechanism: The work sense of striving, the hand as metonym for acquired action, and the blessed right side allow the light to be read as faithful agency made visible and mobile, while the literal spatial reading remains live.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent defines the paired bearers whose light is being displayed.
The work-and-acquisition branch lets the light's motion carry the trace of prior effort.
Hands can index what their bearers have done, supplying the action-to-light attachment.
The literal right hand and right side preserve the scene's embodied spatial axis.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The good announcement immediately names gardens, flowing rivers, permanence, and great success.
baseline_models.mechanism: An advance sign, sheltered growth, uninterrupted flow, and resistance to decay make the announcement a threshold event: the visible light is the first sign that successful passage into continuous life is already underway.

activation_trace.role: The branch of first appearances turns the announcement into an onset rather than detached information.
The garden is a protected, tree-covered destination receiving the advancing group.
Continuous provision gives the river motion a sustaining rather than decorative function.
Persistence without rapid decay closes off the possibility that the arrival is temporary.
Gain joined to rescue makes the destination the completion of a successful passage.

changed_reading.before: The latter half lists rewards that will follow the light scene.
changed_reading.after: The announcement interprets the moving light as the threshold sign of protected, unending arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 57:9 delivered signs move people out from darkness into light; at 57:12 that light has become theirs and itself moves ahead. The context therefore supplies a trajectory from entered illumination to possessed, active guidance.

activation_trace.role: The delivered descent supplies an initiating transfer of signs to the recipients.
Passage outward gives the illumination a directional before-and-after structure.
Illumination is first the destination of extraction from darkness.
The same illumination is now possessed by the believers and acts as the moving subject.
Goal-directed motion converts the earlier destination into an escort that advances.

structural_cues: 57:9 orders delivered signs, exit from darkness, and arrival in light; 57:12 promotes the light to a possessed grammatical agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two light scenes and their directional verbs; I infer continuity and maturation between them. A live alternative is that present guidance and future light are analogous but distinct gifts.

changed_reading.before: The focus introduces an isolated future escort.
changed_reading.after: The running light is the matured form of a passage into illumination begun earlier: first entered, then possessed, then sent ahead.

context_deltas.mechanism: Entrusted resources are spent, figured as a recoverable loan, multiplied, and returned as reward; 57:19 then places reward and light together. This sequence strongly activates the focus hands and work-like striving as the site where entrusted action becomes portable luminosity.

activation_trace.role: The outward movement of wealth begins the action-and-return sequence.
Standing in another's place frames possession as delegated stewardship rather than absolute ownership.
An action or asset cut out now for later recompense supplies the conversion mechanism.
Increase by repeated equivalents marks the return as transformed and amplified.
Recompense for work appears immediately beside the contextual light.
The juxtaposed illumination gives the return a visible, bearer-specific form.
Work and acquisition let the light's activity preserve the history of prior deeds.
The hand-as-deed branch anchors the contextual return in the focus body's forward field.

structural_cues: The spend-loan-multiply-reward chain recurs in 57:7, 57:11, and 57:18 before reward and light are paired in 57:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stewardship, expenditure, deferred recompense, multiplication, and the reward-light pairing; I supply the arrow that prior action is rendered as the focus light. The live alternative is that reward and light remain parallel gifts with no conversion relation.

changed_reading.before: The focus light may only identify the faithful group.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as entrusted action returned in amplified, portable form, visibly carrying the history of what their hands did.

context_deltas.mechanism: The request to take light from others is redirected backward to seek it, after which an elevated enclosure separates the groups. The focus light's forward location therefore gains a temporal force: it is a prior-formed capacity that cannot be obtained retroactively at the sorting boundary.

activation_trace.role: Seeking illumination from another exposes the attempted transfer that the sequence refuses.
Return reverses the group's direction instead of letting it follow the advancing light.
The rearward side supplies the temporal-spatial opposite of the focus light ahead.
A renewed search underscores that the missing light cannot simply be copied on demand.
Separation after former proximity turns the focus preposition into a sorting axis.
The enclosing wall materializes the now-irreversible division between the groups.
The route-marking light belongs ahead of its own bearers and guides them across the division.

structural_cues: 57:13 moves from a plea to wait, through attempted borrowing and a command to go backward, to a wall with opposed sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed transfer, backward redirection, renewed search, and separation; I infer nonretroactive formation of light. A live alternative is a purely spatial exclusion with no claim about when the light was formed.

changed_reading.before: A visible light happens to accompany the believers.
changed_reading.after: Their forward light is a nonretroactive capacity that carries its own bearers across a boundary and cannot be borrowed there.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same act of seeing frames two opposed temporal objects: the focus shows protected gardens and permanence, while 57:20 shows vegetation passing through dry yellowing into fragments. The focus vision is therefore calibrated as sight of what does not undergo the familiar collapse of visible flourishing.

activation_trace.role: Direct sight repeats the focus viewing frame but presents a perishing object.
Drying and yellowing insert visible decline into the comparison scene.
Perishable worldly residue supplies the terminal state opposed to permanence.
The focus asks for equally direct perception of a different temporal order.
The protected garden supplies the flourishing object of the counter-vision.
Resistance to decay makes the contrast temporal rather than merely scenic.

structural_cues: Both 57:12 and 57:20 use a singular second-person act of seeing; the latter adds successive temporal stages, while the focus closes with permanence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated seeing verb and opposed endpoints; I infer that one vision trains the reading of the other. A live alternative is that the scenes are independent examples of afterlife and worldly life.

changed_reading.before: The garden is a conventional lush reward viewed on the day.
changed_reading.after: It is a deliberately counter-seen flourishing whose defining feature is exemption from the visible growth-to-debris cycle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command at 57:21 makes people race toward forgiveness and a garden; in the focus, their light performs the purposeful running and the garden is announced. The earlier pursuit can therefore be read as preserved momentum that has migrated into a guiding light.

activation_trace.role: Competitive advance supplies the human motion toward the promised destination.
The repeated protected garden aligns the endpoint of the race with the focus announcement.
Purposeful motion is transferred from the human imperative to the believers' light.
The moving landmark converts preserved momentum into guidance toward arrival.

structural_cues: 57:21 commands a race toward a garden; 57:12 assigns purposeful motion to light and immediately announces gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel motion and a shared destination; I infer that the prior race is returned as moving guidance. A live alternative is a kinetic echo without causal continuity.

changed_reading.before: The light moves for the believers independently of their own trajectory.
changed_reading.after: Its running can preserve and return the momentum of their earlier race toward the same garden.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 57:28 light is given, made for the recipients, and used as the means by which they walk; in the focus it runs ahead. The light is thus both forerunner and locomotor medium, enabling the movement of those whom it precedes.

activation_trace.role: Giving establishes the light and accompanying portion as received rather than self-originating.
Transformation into a state makes light an appointed capacity for its recipients.
Illumination is explicitly linked to the recipients' subsequent motion.
Literal walking identifies what the made light enables.
The focus intensifies enabled walking by making the guide itself move purposefully.
Its forward placement makes the enabling illumination a guide rather than mere visibility.

structural_cues: The instrumental relation at 57:28 makes light the means of walking; 57:12 then makes that means move in front of the walkers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies giving, making, instrumental walking, and forward running; I infer that both verses describe stages of the same light. A live alternative is that one is present guidance and the other a distinct future manifestation.

changed_reading.before: The light races independently while the believers are passive spectators.
changed_reading.after: It is a received locomotor capacity: it advances before them precisely so that their own advance becomes possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context locates all bounty in God's hand and describes its being given, while the focus places the believers' light at their right sides and before their hands. Any deeds-based reading is therefore constrained by an asymmetry of source and receipt: their light can bear their history without becoming autonomous property.

activation_trace.role: Bounty as benefaction defines the substance located in the giver's control.
The possessing hand marks ultimate control of the bounty rather than recipient ownership.
Giving supplies the directional arrow from source to recipient.
The deed-bearing hands retain a real relation between the recipients' history and their light.
The recipients' right-side location is set against the source hand without collapsing the two.
The possessed illumination is the received benefit whose source remains external.

structural_cues: 57:29 repeats hand language at the source side of giving; 57:12 uses hand and right-side language at the recipient side of manifested light.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounty-in-hand, giving, and the recipients' hand/right-side light; I infer a source-recipient asymmetry that limits merit ownership. A live alternative is that the two hand constructions are independent spatial and possessive idioms.

changed_reading.before: Bearer-specific light could be mistaken for self-produced moral property.
changed_reading.after: The light may register their deeds, but it remains a received bounty whose source and control do not migrate to them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the floral branch of the light root rather than ordinary illumination; it remains anchored by light beside gardens and rivers and by the context's earth-life and plant-decay cycle. Downstream prose should present it only as an ecological material analogy, never as a replacement gloss for the focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The running light immediately opens onto protected vegetation, flowing water, and permanence.

activation_trace.role: The blossom sense lets illumination behave analogically as the first flowering of the announced garden.
Dense, surging vegetation gives the garden a living material continuity with the floral light.
Earth revived through rain and growth supplies the regenerative side of the analogy.
Vegetation produced by rain links flourishing to a recurrent material cycle.
Drying growth supplies the decay stage that the focus permanence resists.
Perishable residue completes the cycle against which the luminous bloom is carried.

changed_reading.before: The light is purely optical and the garden is a separate destination.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the light is the garden's first bloom, carrying regenerated life forward beyond the ordinary rain-growth-decay cycle.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the kindled-fire branch of the light root and reads the adjacent denied-light and fire scenes together; it remains anchored by the packet's shared root inventory, the failed request for light, and the focus light's movement toward rescue. Downstream prose should frame a contrastive material potential, not identify saving light with punitive fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The light moves ahead toward success rather than becoming the bearers' enclosing destination.

activation_trace.role: The kindled-fire branch gives the saving illumination a contained combustive edge without changing its role.
Taking a flame from an originating fire supplies the material logic behind the failed borrowing request.
The contextual fire realizes the same root's consuming branch after access to guiding light has failed.
An enclosing place of resort contrasts with the focus illumination that moves onward.
The hazardous space between rescue and destruction contains the proposed luminous bifurcation.

changed_reading.before: Guiding light and punitive fire are unrelated reward and punishment images.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sequence bifurcates luminosity: mobile light guides its bearers through danger, while denied light is answered by an enclosing fire.

strongest_changes: The focus light becomes the matured, possessed form of an earlier passage out of darkness.
The spend-loan-multiply-reward sequence makes prior entrusted action a plausible source-history for bearer-specific light.
The failed borrowing request and wall make the light nonretroactive and boundary-crossing.
The later walking verse makes the running light both guide and locomotor capacity, while the final hand-of-bounty verse keeps it received rather than autonomous.
The repeated act of seeing contrasts permanent garden life with visible vegetation collapsing into residue.
summary.what_was_special: The context did not collapse the light into one symbol: it simultaneously became prior guidance matured, action returned, a route that cannot be borrowed late, a means of walking, and a gift still controlled at its source. The floral and fire branches preserve two more material analogies under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether action is actually converted into light or reward and light remain parallel gifts.
Whether the hand and right-side wording primarily marks deeds, blessing, power, literal anatomy, or several live layers.
Whether continuity between the light scenes is temporal identity or only structural analogy.
How much weight downstream prose should give the exploratory floral and combustive branches.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Light is the believer’s prior endeavor made locomotive.** س ع ي B001 is purposeful brisk movement and B002 active endeavor; the grammatical subject of **يسعى** is **نورهم**. Earlier belief and spending (57:7–11) supply the latent work, while 57:28 later makes light a means of walking. The packet supplies moving light; I infer prior endeavor -> externalized guide. The scene reads as action returning in luminous, path-making form.
2. **Right sides combine agency and good outcome.** ي م ن B002 is right hand/side, B004 power and rightful force, and B001 blessing and good fortune. **بأيمانهم** sits beside the forward-running light. The packet supplies direction and empowered agency; I infer rightful action -> fortunate accompaniment. The light is not merely around them; it is attached to the side of enacted capacity.
3. **Tidings appear on the face before the destination unfolds.** ب ش ر B005 is face-brightening tidings and B007 first visible signs or forerunners. The announcement precedes gardens and flowing rivers. The packet supplies visible forerunner then destination; I infer first brightness -> advance manifestation of arrival. **بشراكم** reads as the destination beginning to show on its recipients.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:13’s failed request to borrow light reveals that the moving light is identity-bound output, not a detachable lamp. 57:28 explicitly confirms its functional role: it is light **تمشون به**.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Earned action converted into moving light.** `س ع ي` **B002** supplies work, earning, and active endeavor; `ي د ي` **B009** supplies deeds attributed to one's hands, and `ي م ن` **B004** power/rightful force. Belief, expenditure, and lending in 57:7–11 precede the light, while hardened hearts in 57:16 provide the contrary trajectory. The packet supplies acts, hands, and the light's purposeful motion; I infer that enacted trust is converted into navigational illumination. The light reads as conduct made visible and mobile, not an unrelated lamp assigned afterward.
2. **Winning as safe passage through peril.** `ف و ز` **B001** supplies winning good and escape, while dormant **B003** supplies the perilous desert passage between escape and danger. The running light is followed by the barrier of 57:13 and fire in 57:15. The packet supplies guidance, obstacle, and hazard; I infer that light enables the crossing. “The great triumph” consequently reads as successful passage through a dangerous terrain, not possession of a prize alone.
3. **Garden as protective cover with continuing provision.** `ج ن ن` **B003** supplies a tree-covered enclosure and **B008** a protective cover; `ج ر ي` **B006** supplies an ongoing grant or provision. The next ayah places mercy inside an enclosure, and 57:17 revives earth after death. The packet supplies enclosure, flow, and renewal; I infer that the garden's cover preserves the life continuously supplied beneath it. The destination reads as a sustaining habitat, not decorative scenery.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:13's request to borrow light retrospectively exposed the fixed light as non-transferable at that stage, strengthening its relation to hands and endeavor. 57:15's fire made the passage perilous, while 57:17's earth-revival confirmed that the garden is a sustaining growth environment rather than scenery.

baseline.text: O gün inanan erkeklerle inanan kadınları göreceksin; ışıkları önlerinden ve sağ yanlarından ilerleyecek. Bugün müjdeniz, altlarından ırmaklar akan ve içinde sürekli kalacağınız bahçelerdir. İşte büyük başarı budur.

findings.text: Önden ve sağdan ilerleyen ışık, önceki güven ve çabanın kişiye bağlı, hareket eden ve yol açan bir rehbere dönüşmüş görünümüdür.
Sağ yan, yalnız bir yön değil, kişinin doğru eylem gücü ile bunun iyi sonucunu birleştiren etkin taraftır; ışık bu kapasiteye eşlik eder.
Büyük başarı, yalnız bir ödüle sahip olmak değil, ışığın yardımıyla engel ve tehlikeler arasından güvenle geçip kurtuluşa ulaşmaktır.
Bahçeler, süsleyici bir manzaradan öte, akan nimetin beslediği hayatı örten ve kalıcı biçimde koruyan bir yaşam alanıdır.
Müjde, varılacak yer açıklanmadan önce onun sevincini yüzlerde görünür kılan ilk belirti gibi önden gelir.
